title: phase01_core_20260827: Phase 0+1 - spike and environment validation + core headless engine
design: Phase 0: validate vieneu==3.3.0 SDK on real hardware (synthesis contract, infer_stream chunk format, RTF/memory, local model path + HF_HUB_OFFLINE, open questions from plan section 21). Phase 1: headless core engine per plan sections 9/12 - models.py, detector.py, settings.py, audio.py, TTSEngine owning single Vieneu instance, threaded inference worker with request queue + cooperative cancel, --smoke CLI. Sequential: Phase 1 codes against the API contract confirmed by the Phase 0 spike. CPU build stays torch-free.
acceptance_criteria: Phase 0: headless synth works on macOS/Windows/Ubuntu; measured numbers + confirmed API contract recorded in docs/spike-report.md. Phase 1: python -m vienetts_app --smoke produces a valid 48 kHz WAV; unit tests green (detector matrix mocked, settings round-trip, audio WAV encode); ruff + pytest gates pass; coverage >= 80 percent on core; cooperative cancel works between chunks.

title: Task: Phase validation gate
design: Run ruff check, ruff format --check, pytest; coverage >= 80 percent line on src/vienetts_app; verify smoke WAV by soundfile read-back (samplerate 48000, duration > 0, non-silent).
acceptance_criteria: All gates green in one run; coverage report shows >= 80 percent on core; smoke WAV verified.

title: Task: __main__.py - smoke CLI
design: python -m vienetts_app --smoke 'Xin chao' --voice Adam -o out.wav runs end-to-end through the worker; exit codes; prints engine info + output path.
acceptance_criteria: CLI exits 0 and writes a valid 48 kHz WAV via the worker path (not main thread).

title: Task: inference_worker.py - threaded worker
design: TDD: QThread worker + thread-safe request queue; serialized requests; cooperative cancel flag checked between chunks; signals progress/chunkReady/done/error with plan section 9 payloads; single Vieneu ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Requests execute serialized on one thread; cancel stops between chunks; all four signals emit correct payloads; tests green.

title: Task: engine.py - TTSEngine
design: TDD with fake Vieneu: lazy init on first request; wrappers for infer/infer_stream/infer_batch/add_voice/denoise/save per confirmed Phase 0 contract; error propagation.
acceptance_criteria: All wrappers delegate correctly; init is lazy and single-instance; SDK errors surface as actionable exceptions; tests green.

title: Task: audio.py - WAV helpers
design: TDD: float32 @ 48kHz to WAV encode in-memory and to file; WAV header correctness; read-back via soundfile.
acceptance_criteria: Encoded WAV reads back at 48000 Hz with correct duration and channels; in-memory buffer consumable by QBuffer.

title: Task: detector.py - engine detection + heuristic
design: TDD with mocked torch/CUDA: full plan 6.1 detection matrix; 6.2 workload heuristic (streaming->onnx, short->onnx, long/bulk->torch if available); user override resolution. Mirrors SDK for display only.
acceptance_criteria: Every matrix row covered by a test; heuristic cases covered; override resolution covered; no real hardware calls in tests.

title: Task: settings.py - persistence
design: TDD: load/save Settings as JSON via platformdirs.user_data_dir with injectable dir for tests; defaults on first run; corrupt JSON handled gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip test green; missing file yields defaults; corrupt file yields defaults + warning without crash.

title: Task: models.py - data model + validation
design: TDD: EngineInfo, Settings, TTSRequest, TTSProgress per plan section 9 with defaults and input validation.
acceptance_criteria: All four dataclasses construct with plan defaults; invalid values raise validation errors; tests green.

title: Task: Finalize spike report + confirmed API contract
design: Complete docs/spike-report.md: environment matrix, measurements, decisions, API contract (signatures, dtypes/shapes, chunk format, voice-list fields).
acceptance_criteria: Spike report complete and reviewable; Phase 1 coding can start from the documented contract.

title: Task: Cross-OS validation (Windows + Ubuntu)
design: Re-run spike scripts (tasks 2-4) on Windows 10/11 and Ubuntu 22.04+; record env matrix + measurements; note install quirks.
acceptance_criteria: Spike runs on Windows and Ubuntu with numbers recorded; or gap documented in spike report (CI covers in Phase 6) if environment unavailable.

title: Task: Resolve open questions relevant to Phases 0-1
design: Plan section 21 items: PDF lib (PyMuPDF AGPL vs pypdf MIT), mp3 reference-clip decode via soundfile, SDK temperature exposure, mono/stereo channels, voice persistence.
acceptance_criteria: Each open question has a recorded decision + evidence in the spike report; out-of-scope follow-ups filed as beads.

title: Task: Validate offline bundling approach
design: Download weights once; test local model path loading + HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; identify minimal CPU int8 bundle files; draft scripts/fetch_models.py skeleton.
acceptance_criteria: Synthesis works fully offline from local path with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1; minimal bundle file list documented; fetch_models.py skeleton committed.

title: Task: Measure performance and memory
design: Cold start (model load), warm short-text latency, long-text RTF, RSS during synthesis; compare to plan section 18 budgets.
acceptance_criteria: All four measurements recorded in the spike report with comparison to budgets (cold < 15s, warm < 1s, RTF < 1, RSS < 2GB).

title: Task: Confirm infer_stream chunk format + latency
design: Iterate infer_stream(): record chunk dtype, shape, channel count, first-chunk latency, RTF; confirm ONNX-only behavior with backend=torch.
acceptance_criteria: Chunk format documented; first-chunk latency measured vs ~300ms budget; RTF < 1 recorded or deviation explained.

title: Task: Scaffold repo toolchain and install vieneu (CPU stack)
design: pyproject.toml with pinned deps (vieneu==3.3.0; dev: pytest, pytest-qt, ruff), ruff config, .gitignore, src/vienetts_app + tests skeletons, venv install, verify torch-free import.
acceptance_criteria: from vieneu import Vieneu imports in a clean venv without torch; ruff + pytest skeleton runs green; environment matrix started.

title: Task: Validate CPU/ONNX synthesis contract (macOS)
design: Spike script: infer() short vi+en text, list_preset_voices(), add_voice() + cloned infer + persistence check, tts.save(), denoise().
acceptance_criteria: infer returns np.float32 @ 48kHz, duration > 0, non-silent; voice list >= 20 with grouping fields; clone + save verified; findings in docs/spike-report.md draft.

title: Phase 1: Core Engine (Headless)
design: Implement src/vienetts_app per plan section 12: core/models.py (EngineInfo, Settings, TTSRequest, TTSProgress), core/detector.py (detection matrix + workload heuristic + override), core/settings.py (platformdirs + JSON), core/audio.py (WAV encode/export), core/engine.py (TTSEngine owning single lazily-initialized Vieneu), workers/inference_worker.py (QThread + request queue + cooperative cancel + progress/chunkReady/done/error signals), __main__.py --smoke CLI. TDD per conductor workflow.
acceptance_criteria: python -m vienetts_app --smoke 'Xin chào' --voice Adam -o out.wav exits 0 and writes a valid 48 kHz WAV; unit tests green with >= 80 percent line coverage on core; ruff check + ruff format --check + pytest all pass; cancel flag stops long synthesis between chunks.

title: Phase 0: Spike & Environment Validation
design: Spike vieneu==3.3.0 CPU/ONNX stack: repo toolchain scaffold, synthesis contract (infer/list_preset_voices/add_voice/save), infer_stream chunk format + latency, RTF/memory measurements, offline bundling (local model path + HF_HUB_OFFLINE), resolve plan section 21 open questions, cross-OS validation, finalize docs/spike-report.md.
acceptance_criteria: Headless synthesis works via scripted spike on macOS/Windows/Ubuntu; measured numbers recorded; API contract (signatures, dtypes/shapes, chunk format, voice-list fields) documented in docs/spike-report.md.
